answer: Make vouching a slow-burning resource. Each seat earns one non-transferable vouch token per 10 epochs of age, and a new seat is paid only after two vouches from seats older than 20 epochs. If a vouchee is caught as a clone, the voucher loses the token and its regrowth clock restarts. Like an ember, a token can't be fanned faster, so a farm grows only as fast as its oldest seats' clocks; buying a flood overnight is a fable. The ledger works as a prism, splitting each seat's standing into dated vouch links, so a ring hanging off one old sponsor shows up as a single bright band.
